findings.claim: The new @deprecated note on EnhancedTable directs its 9 consumers to features/spaces/components/PaginatedDataTable, but features/spaces/index.ts does not export PaginatedDataTable and the consumers (components/settings, balances, recovery, spending-limits) live outside that feature, so following the note requires deep-importing another feature's internals.

The PR adds a panel variant, a TableSortIcon component and a new stylesheet to the shared table primitive in components/ui without a note on whether this was coordinated with any open design-system PR that also rewrites components/ui/table.tsx.

The same sort-header class list (including group/sort, which TableSortIcon's documentation requires its parent to carry) is duplicated across three files instead of being centralized, e.g. as a shared TableSortButton or class next to TableSortIcon in ui/table.tsx.
The same duplicated sort-header class list also appears here.
The same duplicated sort-header class list also appears here.

The new data-no-divider behavior when highlighted is true has no test coverage; SafeAccountTableRow.test.tsx never checks the highlighted state or the divider, so removing this branch would not fail any test.
The new data-no-hover attribute set when highlighted is true has no test coverage, so removing this branch would not fail any test.
TableSortIcon's three direction branches are untested.

The panel-variant tests only assert the presence or absence of the background class string bg-[var(--color-background-paper)] rather than checking actual behavior, so the test would still pass even if the panel variant stopped correctly applying its header bar, pills, and dividers.
The same shallow class-only assertion problem also appears in this test.

Non-panel EnhancedTable instances (AssetsTable, OwnerList, ProposersList, and others) change corner radius from rounded-3xl to rounded-lg, a visible design change that is not backed by a cited design decision in the PR.

In PaginatedDataTable, the idle sort hint changed from showing at 50% opacity to being hidden until hover or focus, and all sortable headers changed from chevrons to arrows, both visible design changes not backed by a cited design decision in the PR.
A comment claiming this rule outranks TableCard's '.container thead th' is now incorrect, because the PR deletes the cardTable.module.css stylesheet that comment refers to.
